name: Last Soul Ultra
subtitle: Ultra training and coaching
description:
Train with Last Soul Ultra. Keep your running and strength sessions, training calendar, progress and coaching conversations together.

YOUR TRAINING
See today's sessions, follow structured workouts, record a run and review your training history.

YOUR COACHING
Access your coaching accounts, workout feedback and messages. Available plans and coaching features depend on your account.

YOUR HEALTH AND RECOVERY
Review the health measurements you choose to share. With your permission, Apple Health can supply supported activity and health data. Optional device connections require a compatible device or service.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Manage your profile, preferences and connections. Last Soul Ultra uses its own training service and accounts. Primary training records are stored in Germany.

Last Soul Ultra provides training information and is not a medical service. Location, microphone and health permissions are requested for the features that use them.
